item.description:
# Shruti 1.4.3
- Cuts steady background discovery work by combining Shruti's raw and owner-resolved audio activity into one Core Audio process-registry pass. - Throttles status-driven discovery refreshes and uses a two-second low-priority fallback while retaining immediate Core Audio start/stop notifications, so a new playing app is still picked up promptly. - Preserves the independent `ShrutiService`, evidence-only mixer, device ordering, Frequently Used routes and safe device removal introduced in 1.4.2.
